home.title: JetScope Aviation Fuel Transition Decision Entry
home.description: A five-minute view of Europe jet fuel stress signals, SAF tipping-point events, EU ETS cost impact, and AI-assisted research workflows.

faq.meta_description: JetScope FAQ for launch readiness, source review, research workbench boundaries, scenario writes, and protected operations.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question: Is this state a product failure, or is the capability intentionally not enabled?

scope.title: What can JetScope review today?
scope.why: The stated review scope shows which decisions the product can support without overstating its reach.
scope.body: JetScope combines jet-fuel prices, SAF breakeven pressure, EU reserve stress, source quality, saved scenario assumptions, and research signals into one review workflow.

readiness.title: Why can launch readiness be not ready?
readiness.why: Separating configuration gaps from product failures makes the correct recovery action clear.
readiness.body: Launch readiness reports the actual environment. Missing management configuration, disabled AI research, database issues, or degraded source coverage are disclosed as blockers or review items instead of being hidden.

sources.title: How should I read degraded or fallback sources?
sources.why: A degraded source changes where its figures are safe to use and therefore needs review before citation.
sources.body: Source review separates live, proxy, fallback, unavailable, and error states. A degraded source can still be useful, but it should be reviewed before procurement or reporting use.

research.title: Why might the research workbench be disabled?
research.why: Disabled research is not evidence that the market produced no new signal.
research.body: The Research workbench does not pretend that AI analysis is live when the pipeline is disabled or credentials are incomplete. It shows the boundary and the next review actions.

scenarios.title: Can I save scenarios or refresh market data here?
scenarios.why: Protected writes need explicit authorization before a read-only state can be treated as a malfunction.
scenarios.body: Scenario writes and refresh operations are protected. Without the configured management token, localized FAQ pages and review surfaces stay read-only and link back to the primary workspaces.

limitations: These answers describe the current deployment design intent and do not change with live data; use the Admin page for the environment’s actual readiness.
The FAQ does not replace the current states and limitations on the Sources, Research, or Scenarios pages.

scenarios.meta_description: English JetScope scenario review surface for saved assumptions, market context, risk signals, and protected write boundaries.
scenarios.title: Scenario Workbench
scenarios.question: Do the saved assumptions still represent the current market?

transition_signal.label: Transition signal
transition_signal.hint: The current tipping-point model’s view of SAF cost versus fossil jet.
transition_signal.hint_fallback: The tipping-point API did not return a result; the current conclusion is a built-in assumption.

data_posture.label: Data posture
data_posture.hint: {count} key inputs use assumptions or unavailable data.
data_posture.hint_fallback: The market snapshot API is on fallback; numbers on this page are not freshly observed market facts.

airline_signal.label: Airline decision signal
airline_signal.hint: Maps reserve, carbon price, and jet-fuel inputs into discussable airline action probabilities.

reserve.label: Reserve coverage
reserve.hint_fallback: Live reserve data is unavailable; the current week count is only an editable scenario assumption.

assumption_posture.label: Assumption posture
assumption_posture.hint_fallback: The market read-model fallback does not make saved assumptions reliable by itself.
assumption_posture.hint_review: Source posture, risk, or missing scenarios require review before carrying assumptions forward.
assumption_posture.hint_ok: Current source posture and risk window show no immediate review trigger.

saved_scenarios.label: Saved scenarios
saved_scenarios.hint: Workspace assumptions are available for comparison.
saved_scenarios.hint_empty: No saved scenario yet; create one in the primary scenario editor.

risk_signal.label: Highest risk signal
risk_signal.none_hint: The market history window has not produced a ranked alert yet.

readiness_panel.title: Transition monitoring
readiness_panel.why: Place fuel price, carbon price, reserve pressure, and policy targets in one workspace to see which SAF paths are close to an executable range.

registry_panel.title: Scenario management
registry_panel.why: Save and review team-confirmed transition assumptions; protected writes stay in this primary workspace.

capabilities_panel.title: Workspace capabilities
capabilities_panel.why: These capabilities explain how readers can use scenarios, without treating workflow copy as a market conclusion.

capabilities.title: Save assumptions
capabilities.body: Save oil price, carbon price, subsidy, and route cost as reusable decision versions.

capabilities.title: Compare pressure
capabilities.body: Compare the current market, reserve pressure, and policy targets to see which path becomes viable first.

capabilities.title: Sensitivity scan
capabilities.body: Scan ranges around fuel, carbon price, and subsidy to find the inputs that move the conclusion most.

duties_panel.title: Page responsibilities
duties_panel.why: Keep the scenario page’s choice question separate from the cockpit, crisis monitor, and source-review pages.

duties: Live prices live on the decision cockpit and answer what is happening now.
Crisis monitoring explains the source of pressure and answers why action is needed.
The scenario workspace saves assumptions and comparisons and answers how to choose next.
Source review on the sources page answers whether the evidence chain behind the numbers is reliable enough.

assumptions_panel.title: Scenario assumptions
assumptions_panel.why: Saved workspace records show which assumptions are available for comparison and review.
assumptions_panel.empty: No saved assumptions are available yet. Use the primary scenario editor to create reviewable cases for pricing, reserve, route, and policy discussions.

context_panel.title: Decision context
context_panel.why: Scenarios become decision-relevant only alongside current evidence; fallback and missing-signal boundaries stay visible.

context_paragraphs: Scenarios are evidence records for review and team discussion; they do not replace procurement approval, source validation, or protected admin configuration.
Before comparing assumptions, confirm that source coverage and launch readiness are not hiding fallback or disabled-state boundaries.
scenarios.delivery_fallback: Local API fallback is active: {error}. Review assumptions against source evidence before use.

review_panel.title: Review workflow
review_panel.why: The next steps move from saved assumptions back to evidence, launch readiness, and protected write boundaries.

scenarios.write_boundary_body: create, update, and delete actions remain in the primary scenario workspace.

actions.label: Open primary scenario editor
actions.description: Create, update, or delete scenarios in the primary workspace where admin-token writes are already guarded.

actions.label: Review source evidence
actions.description: Check fallback, proxy, degraded, and volatility rows before using saved assumptions in decisions.

actions.label: Open decision cockpit
actions.description: Return to the live market snapshot, source posture, and top risk signal.

actions.label: Check launch readiness
actions.description: Confirm whether protected writes, source coverage, and research prerequisites are ready.

scenarios.source_dashboard_fallback: Market snapshot API unavailable; internal fallback values are being used
scenarios.source_dashboard_live: Market snapshot API (source posture, confidence, fallback rate, and freshness)
scenarios.source_tipping_fallback: Tipping-point analysis unavailable; built-in scenario assumptions are being used
scenarios.source_tipping_live: Tipping-point analysis API (SAF cost signal derived from market inputs)
scenarios.source_airline_fallback: Airline-decision analysis unavailable; built-in scenario assumptions are being used
scenarios.source_airline_live: Airline-decision analysis API (action probabilities derived from market and reserve inputs)
scenarios.source_reserve_fallback: Reserve signal unavailable; an editable week-count assumption is being used
scenarios.source_store: Local scenario store (saved team assumptions, not market observations)
scenarios.source_policy_empty: RefuelEU policy targets have not been returned yet
scenarios.source_risk: Risk signal derived from movement in the market history window, not supplied directly by upstream
limitations: Saved scenarios are local assumptions for review and discussion; they do not replace procurement approval.
A fallback read model keeps the page available but does not provide a valid data-as-of for its replacement values.
No risk signal with a thin sample does not mean there is no risk.
Protected writes remain in the primary scenario workspace.
